what: Frozen Milestone 2 baseline: sha256 of every results/milestone2 file and the per-run numbers of its benchmarks

m2_full_connectome_estimate.label: ESTIMATE — extrapolated from measured subgraph runs, not measured on the full connectome

ram.note: per event: gather index (8 B) + targets (4 B) + weights (4 B) + aggregation (~8 B); plus one float64 N-vector

caveats: subgraphs are denser than the whole brain: mean out-degree expand_100 35, expand_1k 103, expand_50k 156, expand_10k 177 vs 108 in the full store
activity of the full brain under the same gain is unknown; spike fractions are scenarios, not predictions
the linear cost model ignores cache effects that grow with array size
event-driven update fraction is interpolated from subgraph runs (arriving events per neuron per step)
